name: Hypertensive Disorders: Preeclampsia, Eclampsia and HELLP

reference.pathophysiology: Shallow trophoblast invasion leaves spiral arteries narrow ischaemising placenta releasing antiangiogenic factors injuring endothelium leaking protein and clamping vessels; cerebral vasospasm seizes while hepatic capsule stretches banding epigastrium, and platelets consume bleeding.
